# Wuzzuf

> Leading job search platform connecting employers and job seekers across Saudi Arabia and the Middle East, specializing in technology, sales, engineering, and business roles.

Wuzzuf is the premier employment marketplace in the Arab world, featuring thousands of job listings primarily in Saudi Arabia (especially Riyadh, Jeddah, and Makkah) and Egypt. The platform focuses heavily on technology roles including ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), software development (React.js, .NET), and enterprise solutions, alongside sales, accounting, and engineering positions.

## Key Topics

- Saudi Arabia job market
- Riyadh employment opportunities
- Oracle and SAP enterprise systems
- ERP implementation and consulting
- React.js and .NET development
- Sales and account management
- Digital transformation services
- Remote and on-site work arrangements
- Technical support and IT infrastructure
- Engineering and contracting roles
- Accounting and finance positions
- CRM and business development
- Full-time employment opportunities
- Arrow Digital Transformation
- RESTful API development
